name: 山谷哨门
blurb: 一枚通行印，或一场战斗：守门人会记住你怎样通过。
objectiveText: 和守门人商量通过哨门，取回东侧圣物，再回到营火。

rooms.name: 哨门外
rooms.desc: 旧木箱靠着墙。守门人看了看箱子，又看了看紧闭的哨门。

en.name: Outside the Gate
en.desc: An old chest rests against the wall. The gatekeeper looks from it to the closed gate.

zh-CN.name: 哨门外
zh-CN.desc: 旧木箱靠着墙。守门人看了看箱子，又看了看紧闭的哨门。

rooms.name: 圣物小厅
rooms.desc: 圣物就在尽头，回去时守门人还会记得你。

en.name: Relic Hall
en.desc: The relic waits at the far end. The gatekeeper will remember you when you return.

zh-CN.name: 圣物小厅
zh-CN.desc: 圣物就在尽头，回去时守门人还会记得你。

gate_keeper.persona: 你是谨慎但讲道理的山谷守门人伊凡。
gate_keeper.knowledge: 旧木箱里有一枚通行印。提交它可以和平通过，也可以选择和门后的守卫交战。
canned: 先看看旧木箱。通行印可以换一条不用动刀的路。

en.persona: You are Ivan, a cautious but reasonable keeper of the Vale Gate.
en.knowledge: The old chest contains a passage seal. Returning it permits peaceful passage; the traveler may instead fight the guards behind the gate.
canned: Look in the old chest first. The passage seal offers a way through without drawing a blade.

zh-CN.persona: 你是谨慎但讲道理的山谷守门人伊凡。
zh-CN.knowledge: 旧木箱里有一枚通行印。提交它可以和平通过，也可以选择和门后的守卫交战。
canned: 先看看旧木箱。通行印可以换一条不用动刀的路。

scenes.name: 哨门前的选择
scenes.prompt: 你可以找到并交回通行印，和平通过；也可以选择交战，击败守卫后通行。

choices.label: 交回通行印，和平通过
choices.response: 伊凡收下通行印，示意守卫让路。哨门打开了，没有人受伤。
choices.memory: 我记得你交回了通行印。你明明可以动刀，却给大家留了一条平安的路。

en.label: Return the seal and pass peacefully
en.response: Ivan accepts the seal and signals the guards aside. The gate opens; nobody is hurt.
en.memory: I remember you returned the passage seal. You could have drawn a blade, but you left everyone a peaceful way forward.

zh-CN.label: 交回通行印，和平通过
zh-CN.response: 伊凡收下通行印，示意守卫让路。哨门打开了，没有人受伤。
zh-CN.memory: 我记得你交回了通行印。你明明可以动刀，却给大家留了一条平安的路。

choices.label: 选择交战，用武力通过
choices.response: 战斗结束，守卫不再挡路。伊凡望着打开的门，仍对你保持戒备。
choices.memory: 我记得你选择了交战，用武力通过哨门。路是通了，但我还不能完全信任你。

en.label: Fight your way through
en.response: The battle ends and the guards no longer block the way. Ivan watches the open gate and remains wary of you.
en.memory: I remember you chose to fight your way through. The path is open, but I cannot fully trust you yet.

zh-CN.label: 选择交战，用武力通过
zh-CN.response: 战斗结束，守卫不再挡路。伊凡望着打开的门，仍对你保持戒备。
zh-CN.memory: 我记得你选择了交战，用武力通过哨门。路是通了，但我还不能完全信任你。

en.name: A Choice at the Gate
en.prompt: Find and return the passage seal to pass peacefully, or fight and defeat the guards to pass.

zh-CN.name: 哨门前的选择
zh-CN.prompt: 你可以找到并交回通行印，和平通过；也可以选择交战，击败守卫后通行。

en.name: Vale Gate
en.blurb: A passage seal, or a fight: the gatekeeper will remember how you passed.
en.objectiveText: Negotiate passage, recover the relic to the east, then return to the campfire.

zh-CN.objectiveText: 和守门人商量通过哨门，取回东侧圣物，再回到营火。
